craft_notes: Sthāyin: the sixfold close. Sanskrit-first: meyāṃśagāmī kept the going-with-knowable frame; mātṛviśrāntyā kept the name-source; padā/mantra/varṇā-dhvā kept the three path-names; ekasyaiva ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ yuktam kept the closing verdict whole. Rows: 9 (three-dhvā roll), 2 (long compounds spilling), 1 ('thus the one's sixfoldness is warranted' closes — ṣaḍvidha verdict). Close: 'thus the one's sixfoldness is warranted.' Rejected: naming the six facets separately — killed: the verse already names them (the roll IS the six); 'legitimated' — kept warranted (yuktam).

lines: in such viśrānti own-nature is gained:
thus the one's sixfoldness is warranted.
l4.sanskrit_cite: meyāṃśagāmī sthūlasūkṣmapararūpatvāt trividho bhuvanatattvakalātmādhvabhedaḥ mātṛviśrāntyā tathaiva trividhaḥ tatra pramāṇatāyāṃ padādhvā pramāṇasyaiva kṣobhataraṃgaśāmyattāyāṃ mantrādhvā tatpraśame pūrṇapramātṛtāyāṃ varṇādhvā sa eva ca asau tāvati viśrāntyā labdhasvarūpo bhavati iti ekasyaiva ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ yuktam

reads_against.argmap: What is the sixfoldness? → The ekasya ṣaḍvidhatva: one path, six facets — mātṛviśrānti names the triple distinction, and padā/mantra/varṇa-dhvā complete the six, closing in labdhasvarūpa.
c1_essence: One path sixfold: mātṛviśrānti's triple distinction, padā-mantra-varṇa-dhvā — own-nature gained, warranted.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of a scheme counted (wonder at arithmetic settling)
